Class CreatedSlotGroup

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.slotkit.api.slot.CreatedSlotGroup
public class CreatedSlotGroup extends Object
A group of slots: their Storage, shift-click priority, right-click handler and layout.

The group owns its slots' structure (storage, layout, pairing, priority) but not their behavior. Accepting, removing, stack limits, quick-move, binding and mending all resolve from the WindowEngine, keyed by each slot's CreatedSlot.address(). So a group declares its structure once and behavior is set by address, defaulting to plain vanilla. Slots carry only identity, and the group only structure.

Hierarchy: Screen, then Panel, then CreatedSlotGroup, then CreatedSlot.

    • pairsWith

      public CreatedSlotGroup pairsWith(CreatedSlotGroup target)
      Makes shift-click from this group prefer target over numeric priority. This is how furnace-style routing works: fuel goes to the fuel slot, and smeltable items to the input slot.
